title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: supervisors can edit and override submitted quality evaluations
notes: claim 54: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents an API for the summary-regeneration setting that the controls table reports as undocumented. The editing procedure, permissions and roadmap details are supported, but the assertion that representatives and customers see no direct change is not documented.

claims.claim: Supervisors with the required permissions can edit and resubmit a completed quality evaluation.
claims.quote: Edit evaluations and modify responses in an evaluation after it's submitted. When you submit an evaluation, it initially appears in a read-only view. Select Edit to update answers and then submit the changes.

claims.claim: Summary regeneration is skipped if no responses changed, to optimize performance and cost.
claims.quote: If you don't make any changes, the system skips summary regeneration to optimize performance and cost.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the Edit capability is enabled by default on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Dynamics 365 edit submitted evaluations enable disable default switch override submitted evaluation'. Opened Use evaluations, Manage quality evaluation and Evaluation Global Config; none states the arrival default of Edit.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor Learn describes a new data source for editing existing evaluation answers.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Dynamics 365 edit submitted evaluations enable disable default switch override submitted evaluation'; read roadmap, Use evaluations and Manage quality evaluation. Editing is described as updating responses on an existing evaluation, with no new edit-specific data source.

claims.claim: Quality evaluation requests consent for potential data movement across regions.

claims.claim: Service calls might be routed outside the customer's regional boundary when local capacity is temporarily unavailable.
claims.quote: For optimal performance, the system might route service calls outside the customer's regional boundary if local capacity is temporarily unavailable.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a credit rate specific to editing a submitted evaluation.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Dynamics 365 quality evaluation editing regenerate summary Copilot credits rate licensing' and '"quality evaluation" "summary" "credits" "rate"'. Opened Use evaluations, Manage quality evaluation, billing and Agent usage estimator; no edit-specific rate.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated a credit rate specific to regenerating an evaluation summary.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Dynamics 365 quality evaluation editing regenerate summary Copilot credits rate licensing' and '"quality evaluation" "summary" "credits" "rate"'. Read feature pages, billing and estimator; generic billing-rate results do not identify evaluation-summary regeneration.

claims.claim: The Use evaluations page lists no licence requirement beyond its prerequisites.
claims.quote: Prerequisites: Enable quality evaluation. Assign the required roles and privileges. Set up Microsoft Copilot credits. Provide consent for potential data movement across regions.

claims.claim: Quality evaluation lists assignment of Quality Manager, Quality Evaluator and Quality Administrator roles as a prerequisite.
claims.quote: Assign the Quality Manager, Quality Evaluator, and Quality Administrator roles.

claims.claim: Quality evaluation requires Enable AI agents to be turned on for the Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Turn on Enable AI agents for your Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: The documented security-role assignment is made within an environment.
claims.quote: In the Manage pane, select Environments, and then select an environment from the list. Select Settings. ... On the Users page select a user, and then select Manage security roles.

claims.claim: Role assignment is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Users > user > Manage security roles.
claims.quote: select Manage. ... select Environments, and then select an environment ... Select Settings. ... Select Users + permissions, and then select Users. ... select a user, and then select Manage security roles.

claims.claim: POST /api/data/v9.0/systemusers(azureactivedirectoryobjectid=<user object ID>)/systemuserroles_association/$ref assigns a security role.
claims.quote: POST [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.0/systemusers(azureactivedirectoryobjectid=<user object ID>)/systemuserroles_association/$ref

claims.claim: The cited API procedure is documented for assigning a role to a Microsoft Entra ID group user.
claims.quote: An administrator can assign a security role to a Microsoft Entra ID group user.

claims.claim: The role-assignment request body sets @odata.id to the role.
claims.quote: "@odata.id":"[Organization URI]/api/data/v9.0/roles(<role ID>)"

claims.claim: The setting is at Copilot Service admin center > Customer Support > Quality management > Quality evaluation > Manage > Evaluation summary > Regenerate evaluation summary.
claims.quote: go to Customer Support > Quality management. ... Select Manage for Quality evaluation. ... In the Evaluation summary section, turn on Regenerate evaluation summary.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for the summary-regeneration setting.
claims.quote: Update ... PATCH /msdyn_evaluationglobalconfigs(msdyn_evaluationglobalconfigid) ... msdyn_enablesummaryregeneration ... Global flag to enable or disable the summary regeneration feature
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api null with kind 'rest', call 'PATCH /msdyn_evaluationglobalconfigs(<msdyn_evaluationglobalconfigid>)', and docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/msdyn_evaluationglobalconfig'. Add to its note: 'The request body sets msdyn_enablesummaryregeneration to true or false.' Cite that reference in sources and update the rendered API cell consistently.

claims.claim: Disabling Regenerate evaluation summary hides Generate Summary from evaluators.
claims.quote: If you disable the option: The Generate Summary option is hidden from evaluators.

claims.claim: The setting controls evaluators' ability to generate manual summaries and regenerate summaries for completed AI-assisted and AI agent evaluations.
claims.quote: Evaluators can't generate summaries for manual evaluations or regenerate summaries for completed AI-assisted and AI agent evaluations.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly state whether disabling the setting stops automatic regeneration triggered by submitting an edit.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Dynamics 365 quality evaluation regenerate evaluation summary setting table entity reference API' and '"Regenerate evaluation summary" "msdyn"'. Read both feature pages and Evaluation Global Config; no explicit disabled-setting behavior for automatic submission regeneration.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document a separate switch for disabling editing of submitted evaluations.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Dynamics 365 edit submitted evaluations enable disable default switch override submitted evaluation'. Read Use evaluations, Manage quality evaluation and Evaluation Global Config; found role/privilege requirements but no separate edit-disable switch.

claims.claim: Removing the qualifying roles and override privilege is the documented permission-based way to restrict who can edit.
claims.quote: Select or deselect security roles. ... all selected roles become the current assigned roles for the user. Unselected roles aren't assigned.

claims.claim: Agents and customers see nothing directly from this change.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Dynamics 365 "submitted evaluations" "customers" "representatives"'. Read Use evaluations and Manage quality evaluation; they describe supervisor/evaluator workflows but do not state that representatives and customers see no direct change.
claims.fix: Remove 'agents and customers see nothing directly' from the impact rationale. Use: 'Low. Supervisors and quality administrators use the Edit action; edited scores can change what reports show.'

claims.claim: The prose reports no separate edit-disable switch, but the controls table does not represent that absence.
claims.quote: Microsoft Learn documents no separate switch that turns off editing of submitted evaluations ... Controls rows: security role assignment; Regenerate evaluation summary.
claims.fix: Remove the sentence beginning 'Microsoft Learn documents no separate switch' from Governance controls; the preceding role-permission explanation already supplies the actionable guidance. Do not add a control row.
